pull_requests.body:
## Current review scope
CIS Control 1 only: canonical 1.1–1.5 guided definitions, implementation-group applicability, versioned historical preservation, concise narratives, separate gaps/unknowns, constrained accessible Omni character and docking. No AI service or new dependencies.

Dashboard cleanup is isolated in commit 6030ad0. Current review head: 5fd3fd310c2e38e360a9123baeb04e9f26e7be18. Local HEAD equals remote branch HEAD.

## Release boundary
Keep this PR draft and unmerged. Do not merge main, publish Sites, deploy production or reset staging. The user authorized deploying the exact reviewed commit only to the existing Render staging service after CI validation. Previous staging rollback reference: cefc2c26c99f06c86b409ed9903e0037bcdfea8e / dep-db33j48m7kps73ctllvg. Deployment has not yet been performed for this head.

## Verification checkpoint
- 649 offline backend tests and 698 subtests passed; eight existing FastAPI lifecycle warnings.
- 80 focused frontend tests passed; subsequent 11-test guidance/priority rerun passed.
- Normal staging and isolated Demo builds passed.
- Full frontend run and exact-head CI pending; no passing claim yet.
- Independent Control 1 review found no remaining concrete blocker after corrections.
- Local synthetic browser: Brawndo IG1 and Initech IG2, resume/refresh, unknown and gap branches, replacement protection, Apply/native Save & next, keyboard/focus, docking/reset, light/dark and 1440/1024/768.
- These local Demo checks are NOT real authenticated hosted persistence proof. Hosted post-deployment evidence will be appended separately.

Current content matrix, history rules and outside-feature change justification: docs/omni-guided-assessment-pilot.md. Historical two-safeguard checkpoint remains preserved below its superseding section.
